## ConnectionsModule.acceptRequest() method

Accept a connection request as inviter (by sending a connection response message) for the connection with the specified connection id. This is not needed when auto accepting of connection is enabled.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
acceptRequest(connectionId: string): Promise<ConnectionRecord>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type   | Description                                              |
| ------------ | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| connectionId | string | the id of the connection for which to accept the request |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[ConnectionRecord](./core.connectionrecord.md)&gt;

connection record
